name: New England Aquarium
tagline: Starter list: African penguins, then Myrtle the green sea turtle and Giant Ocean Tank sharks.

practical.ticket_note: Harbor location; combine with the waterfront walk.

items.label: African penguin
items.one_liner: About 50 African and southern rockhopper penguins — start with the African colony.

qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

bonus_hunt.tagline: New England bonus · Penguin Colony + Myrtle + sharks

challenges.text: African penguin: watch one bird enter or leave the water.
Myrtle: flippers busy or a still float?
Giant Ocean Tank: count the fins you can see at once.
Sea Jellies: watch one pulse from top to bottom.
